newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange volume slips, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange volume slips, prices mixed.

text.p: The Istanbul gold exchange had a quiet day on Monday with volume slipping to 676 kilos from Friday's 2,330 kilos as conditions for arbitrage trading became less favourable, dealers said.
"There is some physical demand on the market at the moment which made up most of the day's volume, but about 200 kilos of the trade was due to arbitrage," one dealer said.

Gold closed easier in dollar terms at $344.65 an ounce, compared to $346.90 on Friday, following weaker levels on world markets. But it firmed in lira terms to 1,574,000 per gram from 1,573,500, as the lira weakened against the dollar.
The lira closed at 141,720 per dollar, easier than Friday's 140,410.
Most of the day's trade -- 595 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 66.0 percent of trade conducted in dollar terms.
